chapters.name: Physical World & Measurement
chapters.theory: Physics is the study of nature and natural phenomena. SI system has 7 base units: meter (length), kilogram (mass), second (time), ampere (current), kelvin (temperature), candela (luminous intensity), mole (amount of substance).

chapters.name: Kinematics
chapters.theory: Kinematics deals with motion without considering forces. For uniform acceleration: v = u + at, s = ut + ½at², v² = u² + 2as. In projectile motion, range R = u²sin(2θ)/g, max height H = u²sin²θ/(2g). Time of flight T = 2usinθ/g.

chapters.name: Laws of Motion
chapters.theory: Newton's First Law: Inertia. Second Law: F = ma (Force = mass × acceleration). Third Law: Action-Reaction. Friction f = μN, where μ is coefficient of friction. Centripetal force F = mv²/r. Banking angle tanθ = v²/rg.

chapters.name: Work, Energy & Power
chapters.theory: Work W = F·s (dot product). Kinetic Energy KE = ½mv². Potential Energy PE = mgh (gravitational). Power P = W/t = F·v. Work-Energy Theorem: Work done = Change in KE. For spring: PE = ½kx².

chapters.name: System of Particles & Rotational Motion
chapters.theory: Center of mass is the average position of mass. Moment of inertia I = Σmr². Torque τ = r × F = Iα. Angular momentum L = Iω. Conservation of angular momentum: L₁ = L₂. Parallel axis theorem: I = I_cm + Md².

chapters.name: Gravitation
chapters.theory: Universal law: F = Gm₁m₂/r². Gravitational acceleration g = GM/R². Escape velocity v_esc = √(2GM/R). Orbital velocity v_orb = √(GM/r). Kepler's Third Law: T² ∝ r³. Gravitational potential U = -GMm/r.

chapters.name: Mechanical Properties of Solids
chapters.theory: Stress = Force/Area, Strain = ΔL/L. Hooke's Law: Stress ∝ Strain. Young's Modulus Y = Stress/Strain = FL/AΔL. Bulk Modulus B = -ΔP/(ΔV/V). Shear Modulus G = Shear Stress/Shear Strain. Elastic potential energy U = ½ × Stress × Strain × Volume.

chapters.name: Mechanical Properties of Fluids
chapters.theory: Pressure P = F/A. Pascal's Law: Pressure applied to enclosed fluid is transmitted equally. Archimedes' Principle: Buoyant force = weight of displaced fluid. Bernoulli's Theorem: P + ½ρv² + ρgh = constant. Equation of continuity: A₁v₁ = A₂v₂.

chapters.name: Thermal Properties of Matter
chapters.theory: Linear expansion: ΔL = αLΔT. Volume expansion: ΔV = γVΔT. Heat Q = msΔT. Specific heat capacity c = Q/mΔT. Heat transfer: Conduction Q/t = kAΔT/L, Radiation Q = σAT⁴. Newton's Law of Cooling: dT/dt ∝ (T - T₀).

chapters.name: Thermodynamics
chapters.theory: Zeroth Law: Thermal equilibrium. First Law: ΔU = Q - W. Second Law: Heat cannot flow from cold to hot without work. Efficiency η = W/Q_h = 1 - Q_c/Q_h. Carnot efficiency η_max = 1 - T_c/T_h. Entropy ΔS = Q_rev/T.

chapters.name: Kinetic Theory of Gases
chapters.theory: Ideal gas equation: PV = nRT. Kinetic energy per molecule = ½mv_rms² = (3/2)kT. RMS speed v_rms = √(3RT/M). Average speed v_avg = √(8RT/πM). Most probable speed v_mp = √(2RT/M). Degrees of freedom f: Monatomic f=3, Diatomic f=5.

chapters.name: Oscillations
chapters.theory: Simple Harmonic Motion: x = A sin(ωt + φ). Velocity v = Aω cos(ωt + φ). Acceleration a = -ω²x. Time period T = 2π√(m/k) for spring. For pendulum T = 2π√(L/g). Energy in SHM: E = ½kA² = constant.

chapters.name: Waves
chapters.theory: Wave velocity v = fλ. Speed of transverse wave on string v = √(T/μ). Speed of sound v = √(B/ρ). Standing waves: nodes and antinodes. Fundamental frequency f₁ = v/2L for open pipe. Doppler Effect: f' = f(v ± v₀)/(v ∓ v_s). Beats frequency f_beat = |f₁ - f₂|.

chapters.name: Electrostatics
chapters.theory: Coulomb's Law: F = kq₁q₂/r². Electric field E = F/q. Electric potential V = kq/r. Capacitance C = Q/V. Parallel plate capacitor C = ε₀A/d. Energy stored U = ½CV² = ½QV. Dielectric constant K increases capacitance.

chapters.name: Current Electricity
chapters.theory: Ohm's Law: V = IR. Resistivity R = ρL/A. Power P = VI = I²R = V²/R. Kirchhoff's Current Law: ΣI = 0. Kirchhoff's Voltage Law: ΣV = 0. Resistors in series: R_eq = R₁ + R₂ + ..., in parallel: 1/R_eq = 1/R₁ + 1/R₂ + .... Wheatstone bridge balance: R₁/R₂ = R₃/R₄.

chapters.name: Magnetic Effects of Current
chapters.theory: Magnetic field due to wire B = μ₀I/2πr. Force on moving charge F = qvB sinθ. Force on wire F = ILB sinθ. Torque on loop τ = NIAB sinθ. Ampere's Law: ∮B·dl = μ₀I. Solenoid field B = μ₀nI. Cyclotron frequency f = qB/2πm.

chapters.name: Electromagnetic Induction
chapters.theory: Faraday's Law: ε = -dΦ/dt. Lenz's Law: Induced current opposes change. Motional EMF: ε = Blv. Self inductance ε = -L dI/dt. Energy stored in inductor U = ½LI². Mutual inductance ε₂ = -M dI₁/dt. AC generator: ε = NBAω sin(ωt).

chapters.name: Alternating Current
chapters.theory: RMS voltage V_rms = V₀/√2. Capacitive reactance X_C = 1/ωC. Inductive reactance X_L = ωL. Impedance Z = √(R² + (X_L - X_C)²). Resonance ω₀ = 1/√(LC). Power factor cosφ = R/Z. Transformer: V_p/V_s = N_p/N_s = I_s/I_p.

chapters.name: Electromagnetic Waves
chapters.theory: Maxwell's equations predicted EM waves. Speed c = 1/√(μ₀ε₀) = 3×10⁸ m/s. Displacement current I_d = ε₀ dΦ_E/dt. EM spectrum: Radio (λ>0.1m), Microwave (1mm-0.1m), Infrared (700nm-1mm), Visible (400-700nm), UV (10-400nm), X-rays (0.01-10nm), Gamma (<0.01nm). Energy of photon E = hf = hc/λ.

chapters.name: Optics
chapters.theory: Mirror formula: 1/f = 1/v + 1/u. Lens formula: 1/f = 1/v - 1/u. Snell's law: n₁ sinθ₁ = n₂ sinθ₂. Critical angle sinθ_c = n₂/n₁. Power of lens P = 1/f (diopters). Young's double slit: Δy = λD/d. Diffraction minima: a sinθ = nλ. Resolving power R = λ/Δλ.

chapters.name: Dual Nature of Radiation & Matter
chapters.theory: Einstein photoelectric equation: KE_max = hf - φ. Work function φ = hf₀. Threshold frequency f₀ = φ/h. Stopping potential eV₀ = KE_max. de Broglie wavelength λ = h/p = h/mv. For electron accelerated by V volts: λ = h/√(2meV) = 12.27/√V Å.

chapters.name: Atoms
chapters.theory: Bohr radius r_n = n²r₀ (r₀ = 0.529Å). Energy E_n = -13.6/n² eV. Lyman series (UV): n→1. Balmer series (Visible): n→2. Paschen (IR): n→3. Spectral lines: 1/λ = R(1/n₁² - 1/n₂²). Rydberg constant R = 1.097×10⁷ m⁻¹. Angular momentum mvr = nh/2π.

chapters.name: Nuclei
chapters.theory: Mass defect Δm = [Zm_p + Nm_n - M_nucleus]. Binding energy BE = Δm×931.5 MeV. Radioactive decay: N = N₀ e^{-λt}. Half-life T_½ = ln2/λ = 0.693/λ. Mean life τ = 1/λ. Activity A = λN. Nuclear fission splits heavy nucleus, fusion combines light nuclei.

chapters.name: Semiconductor Electronics
chapters.theory: Forward bias reduces barrier, reverse bias increases barrier. Rectifier converts AC to DC. Zener diode acts as voltage regulator. Transistor α = I_C/I_E, β = I_C/I_B. OR gate: A+B, AND gate: A·B, NOT gate: Ā. NAND and NOR are universal gates. Amplifier gain A_v = V_out/V_in.
